arguments.command:
python -c "
import datetime as dt

# Test very large timedelta
try:
    td = dt.timedelta(days=999999999)
    print(f'Large timedelta: {td}')
    print(f'days: {td.days}')
    print(f'seconds: {td.seconds}')
    print(f'microseconds: {td.microseconds}')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'Error: {type(e).__name__}: {e}')

# Test even larger
try:
    td = dt.timedelta(days=10**15)
    print(f'Even larger: {td}')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'Error: {type(e).__name__}: {e}')
"
